title: Spreading speeds for prey--predator systems in a shifting environment: a short proof
summary: This note is concerned with the spreading speed of the predator component in a class of prey--predator reaction--diffusion systems with spatiotemporal heterogeneity depending on a moving variable. The main difficulty is that the full system lacks a direct comparison principle. We establish a pointwise estimate showing that the prey density is close to its carrying capacity wherever the predator density is sufficiently small.
